calls.statement:
SELECT calendar_date, day_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-09-28' AND calendar_date <= '2026-10-11'
ORDER BY calendar_date

SELECT 
  s.week_ending_date,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  st.store_id,
  st.store_name,
  s.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week AS s
INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON s.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store AS st ON s.store_key = st.store_key
WHERE p.sku = 100011
  AND st.store_id = 124
  AND s.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.week_ending_date,
  s.closing_units,
  s.receipts_units,
  s.adjustment_units
FROM fact_stock_week AS s
WHERE s.product_key = 11
  AND s.store_key = 30
  AND s.week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-09-20' AND '2026-10-11'
ORDER BY s.week_ending_date
